newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 13.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- 2005 Expo to be held in Aichi Prefecture.
-- Former Japanese Ambassador to Peru Morihisa Aoki and three others reprimanded for Lima hostage crisis.
-- Upper House panel approves medical reform legislation.
-- U.S. asks Japanese and European firms to draw up carbon dioxide reduction plans.
-- Tokyo prosecutors to question Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) Vice President Ichiro Fujita over payoff scandal.
-- Science and Technology Agency eyes development of fully recyclable rocket plane.
-- Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda hints at Japanese support for U.S. military outside of mutual security treaty arrangements.
